note: FUN_1413435b0 釣魚公告的方位，接 ocean／lake／swamps／cavern 等

en: You are caught in a lava mist!
You are caught up in the web!
You are caught in a cloud of flames!
You are caught in a burst of steam!
You are caught in a pool of lava!
You are caught in a pool of magma!
You are completely free of the web.
You are partially free of the web.
You have fully overcome the paralysis.
You have partially overcome the paralysis.
You vomit into the lava mist.
You vomit and bits of it get stuck in the web.
zh-Hant: 你吐了，有些嘔吐物黏在蛛網上。
zh-Hans: 你吐了，有些呕吐物粘在蛛网上。

en: You vomit into the ocean wave.
You vomit into the sea foam.
The rest of the vomit burns away in the lava.
zh-Hant: 剩下的嘔吐物在熔岩中燒光了。
zh-Hans: 剩下的呕吐物在熔岩中烧光了。

en: The vomit burns away in the lava.
zh-Hant: 嘔吐物在熔岩中燒光了。
zh-Hans: 呕吐物在熔岩中烧光了。

en: The rest of the vomit burns away in the magma.
zh-Hant: 剩下的嘔吐物在熔岩中燒光了。
zh-Hans: 剩下的呕吐物在熔岩中烧光了。

en: The vomit burns away in the magma.
zh-Hant: 嘔吐物在熔岩中燒光了。
zh-Hans: 呕吐物在熔岩中烧光了。

en: The rest of the vomit disappears into the water.
zh-Hant: 剩下的嘔吐物消失在水中。
zh-Hans: 剩下的呕吐物消失在水中。

en: The vomit disappears into the water.
The rest of the vomit falls away into the chasm.
zh-Hant: 剩下的嘔吐物掉進了深淵。
zh-Hans: 剩下的呕吐物掉进了深渊。

en: The vomit falls away into the chasm.
The rest of the vomit falls away into the underworld.
zh-Hant: 剩下的嘔吐物掉進了地獄。
zh-Hans: 剩下的呕吐物掉进了地狱。

en: The vomit falls away into the underworld.
The rest of the vomit splatters into the shallow puddle of water.
zh-Hant: 剩下的嘔吐物濺進了淺水窪。
zh-Hans: 剩下的呕吐物溅进了浅水洼。

en: The vomit splatters into the shallow puddle of water.
You collapse and fall to the ground from over-exertion.
zh-Hant: 你因過度勞累而倒在地上。
zh-Hans: 你因过度劳累而倒在地上。

zh-Hant: 你因精疲力竭而昏了過去。
zh-Hans: 你因精疲力竭而昏了过去。

en: You have reverted to a wild state!
Send them back to the darkness!
Protect the hoard from skulking filth!
zh-Hant: 保護寶藏，別讓鬼祟的敗類得逞！
zh-Hans: 保护宝藏，别让鬼祟的败类得逞！

zh-Hant: 詛咒所有大自然的朋友！
zh-Hans: 诅咒所有大自然的朋友！

en: The wilds are turning on us!
You hurl a ball of fire!
You shoot out thick strands of webbing!
